values.B5: update CPU per tick at 250 p95 <= 8.33 ms
values.B6: input to updated-surface capture p95 <= 100 ms ordinary, <= 150 ms dense
values.B8: owned resources after dispose 0; extent cost ratio <= 1.20; zero live-node growth
